candidates.title: Run the site generator check as part of the pre-ship doc-sync trio

evidence.ref: ## One CI failure found and fixed inside this PR

proposedChange.change: In the pre-ship doc-sync trio, add `node bin/build-site.js --check` as an explicit local step after `ws-wiki sync` so a wiki page edit cannot ship with a stale docs/wiki render (the CI site check fails closed otherwise).

candidates.title: Widen or load-adjust the subagent-dispatch child-startup window

evidence.quote: AssertionError: child started before the kill

proposedChange.change: Make the case-8 assertion tolerate machine load: either raise the 400 ms kill window or poll for the alive mark briefly before asserting, so a green suite is not reported red by a Node boot race.

candidates.title: Re-sync the fixture tarball ref before a suite run after any version bump

evidence.quote: test/package.json carries the release tarball ref asserted by test-code-review-round-2.js

proposedChange.change: Record the trap: after `npm run build-site:bump`, `test/package.json` must still point at the bumped tarball before `npm run tests`; if anything restores it, `test-code-review-round-2.js` fails with 'fixture tarball ref tracks package.json version'.
